headline: TEX @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 4.41 at CLE 4.09, with a projected total of 8.50. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TEX: TEX moved +0.15 runs while CLE moved -0.27, changing the projected margin by +0.42 runs. NRFI probability rose +12.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Tanner Bibee has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Chase DeLauter, Brayan Rocchio, Cameron Cauley, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Cooper Ingle because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
